checks.name: Parcel satellite history on bundled synthetic data
checks.sql: SELECT parcel_id, round(mean_index, 2), decline FROM earth_observation.main.parcel_series((SELECT * FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input)) ORDER BY parcel_id, observed_at

checks.name: Empty parcel relation
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM earth_observation.main.parcel_series((SELECT * FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input WHERE false))

checks.name: Multiple input batches without invented observations
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(mean_index), min(status) FROM earth_observation.main.parcel_series((SELECT i::VARCHAR parcel_id, geometry_wkb FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input CROSS JOIN range(2501) t(i) WHERE parcel_id='field-a'), end_date := '2026-01-02')

checks.name: Declines joined to ownership and weather
checks.sql:
WITH owners(parcel_id, owner_name) AS (VALUES ('field-a', 'North Farm'), ('field-b', 'River Farm')),
weather(month_start, rain_mm) AS (VALUES (DATE '2026-07-01', 10.0)),
series AS (SELECT * FROM earth_observation.main.parcel_series((SELECT * FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input)))
SELECT s.parcel_id, o.owner_name, round(s.delta_index, 2) AS delta_ndvi, w.rain_mm::DOUBLE AS rain_mm
FROM series s JOIN owners o USING(parcel_id)
JOIN weather w ON s.observed_at::DATE = w.month_start
WHERE s.decline ORDER BY s.parcel_id

checks.name: SAR known values and explicit missing data
checks.sql: SELECT observed_at::DATE AS observed_date, round(mean_db, 1), status FROM earth_observation.main.radar_series((SELECT parcel_id AS region_id, geometry_wkb FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input WHERE parcel_id='field-a'), polarizations := 'vv') ORDER BY observed_at

checks.name: SAR polarization groups
checks.sql: SELECT polarization, count(mean_db), round(max(mean_db)-min(mean_db), 1) FROM earth_observation.main.radar_series((SELECT parcel_id AS region_id, geometry_wkb FROM earth_observation.main.demo_input WHERE parcel_id='field-a')) GROUP BY polarization ORDER BY polarization
